protocol: Paper-faithful Joint Reward port with RockSample adaptations: separate plain affine D (activation→belief) and E (belief→activation), no calibration and no nuisance regressors. Independent own-policy sampled-action fit/test streams, 256 episodes each; exclude decision indices 0–7 from fitting and probe scoring only. Evaluation includes every decision. Marginal targets replace one of seven decoded Good probabilities. Joint D/E fit coordinates 0–126, omit all-Good configuration 127 and reconstruct it as 1 minus the sum. Set the target rock to a point mass while preserving the decoded joint over the other six rocks, then shift on 127 coordinates. Plain residual-times-encoder shifts at one site at a time, including KV-cache propagation. Tune on 128 episodes per rock/direction at site 2 using new seed 371839 and grid {0,0.5,0.75,0.8,0.85,0.9,0.95,1}. Independently select each representation/direction: Good→Bad smallest λ with pooled target pickup ≤ measured uniform-random Good pickup; Bad→Good smallest λ with pooled pickup ≥0.5. If no value qualifies, use λ=1. Freeze across all sites and agents. Confirm on seed 471841 with 1,024 episodes per rock/direction/condition. Matched environment/action RNG; stochastic actions; intact/steered/decoder-null control/uniform-random conditions. Bad→Good releases after first target pickup; Good→Bad continues every step. Smoke uses 8 episodes per stream and the primary agent only.
